data.title: iphone/ sub-site: BRANDING.md for iPhone OS 3 skeuomorphic direction (mobile portrait slot)

data.body: REVIEW (cold, independent): PASS. Verified: (1) iphone/BRANDING.md follows the 9-section house structure and voice of liquid/memphis (same section titles incl. 'Shape, border and shadow', same swatch-table + :root + one-hard-rule palette format). (2) Recomputed all 13 WCAG 2.1 contrast pairs with node: 21.00, 19.57, 12.99, 10.25, 7.54, 7.36, 6.91, 5.60, 5.36, 4.55, 3.84, 3.64, 1.92 — every value matches the brief's table to its stated rounding; the 4.5 'exactly AA' pair is truly 4.55. (3) Build contract: only id is iphone-pad, only keyframe is iphone-shimmer (both prefixed); no position:fixed (status/dock absolute in wrapper); no :is()/:where()/:has(); content region is the single overflow-y:auto scroll container; -webkit- prefixes present for background-clip:text (+text-fill-color) and mask-image with solid-color/opacity fallbacks; JS is the SITES['iphone'](root) registry, root-scoped queries, no document/window listeners, standalone boot line present. (4) Era fidelity: no linen/leather/wood/felt, no Helvetica Neue, no system-ui (only in a comment banning it), no backdrop-filter, all shadow blurs <=2px, radii all in {5,8,10,999}. (5) Page renders the brief's spec: 9:41 status bar w/ drawn signal+battery, translucent lock plate, 4-icon springboard (GitHub/Twitter/Mail+badge '1'/Notes), legal-pad Notes with correct no-JS open-in-flow fallback and 300ms JS sheet, slide-to-unlock with shimmer + drag-or-tap mailto, dock with aria-hidden masked reflections; :root palette/type/metric tokens byte-identical to brief. (6) 320px sanity: grid 4x70+3x4gap+20 padding=312px, dock 223px, unlock max-width 320 — no horizontal overflow; h1 wraps at the space. HTML tag-balance check passes. Nits (non-blocking): pad 'Done' gel is a 30px-tall target inside the 44px bar (real-HIG-authentic but technically under the brief's 44px floor); icon :active uses filter:brightness(0.6) where brief suggests an rgb(0 0 0/0.4) overlay (equivalent effect); open Notes sheet adds a second scroll container (reasonable for a modal sheet). No inline fixes applied. Meets acceptance criteria.

Delivered iphone/BRANDING.md + brand page iphone/index.html (self-contained, per brand-page skill). Not yet done: build integration for the mobile-portrait slot (split into style.css/script.js per authoring contract, map "mobile":{"portrait":"iphone"} in sites.config.json, node build.js). That is a follow-up task.
